scientific_integrity: Proved only under continuous strictly positive contact renewal at nonsaturated prevalence; exact rational examples check selected inputs. Mathematical existence is analytic, not inferred from computations. No claim of priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover contact-creation responses that vanish before complete prevalence saturation.
No uniqueness, stability, global convergence or unrestricted Conjecture 6 claimed.
Related generic positive fixed-point theory may imply part of the theorem.
title: Spectral-radius endemic existence with positive contact renewal in adaptive SIS networks
